parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the toilet seat, typically made of durable plastic. It is a detachable and ergonomic part designed for user comfort.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides a comfortable sitting surface and can be lifted or lowered for use. It acts as the main interface between the user and the toilet.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward or downward around a hinge for cleaning or use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic. It supports the seat and contains the water passage and waste outlet.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
